test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate collocating word to fill in the blank.

Ram was praised for his________ leadership.
solution: The correct answer is **visionary**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Visionary: **having great plans for the future. भविष्‍य के लिए बड़ी योजनाएँ बनाने वाला; भविष्‍यदर्शी • **Example: **Under her visionary leadership, the city prospered. • Thus, the most appropriate collocation word to fill in the blank is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Imaginary: **existing only in the mind; not real. केवल मन में, काल्‍पनिक; अवास्‍तविक • **Magical: **wonderful and exciting. आश्‍चर्यजनक और उत्तेजक या रोमांचक • **Broad: **wide. चौड़ा 21a:T464, The correct answer is **cut down**.
